From illuminating light and shadow to defining the future. In 2025, we opened a new chapter in LED
point-source technology for film and television with our proprietary BLAIR and BLAIR-CG light
engines. In 2026, we will launch an update to our light engine technology, delivering optical
solutions that revolutionize performance at the source and eliminate the trade-off between
brightness and color. This year also marks a major upgrade to our intelligent control ecosystem and
the debut of an all-new product line. A spectacular showcase of light and shadow awaits, don't miss
it! We look forward to welcoming you!

the STORM and NOVA series with Sidus Link Pro for intelligent, network-based lighting control.

applications throughout the booth, and be among the first to discover exciting new additions to the
Aputure lineup that further expand our professional lighting ecosystem.

[Aputure at BIRTV Beijing]
[BIRTV Beijing][29]
From illuminating light and shadow to defining the future. In 2025, we opened a new chapter in LED
point-source technology for film and television with our proprietary BLAIR and BLAIR-CG light
engines. In 2026, we will launch an update to our light engine technology, delivering optical
solutions that revolutionize performance at the source and eliminate the trade-off between
brightness and color. This year also marks a major upgrade to our intelligent control ecosystem and
the debut of an all-new product line. A spectacular showcase of light and shadow awaits, don't miss
it! We look forward to welcoming you!
8/19/2026
[Aputure at IBC Amsterdam]
[IBC Amsterdam][30]
Discover how Aputure's expanding ecosystem of professional lighting solutions is transforming
broadcast, live production, film, and studio workflows. Rather than showcasing individual products,
our booth demonstrates complete production environments, highlighting the seamless integration of
the STORM and NOVA series with Sidus Link Pro for intelligent, network-based lighting control.
Explore the Sidus Playground to experience advanced lighting workflows firsthand, see real-world
applications throughout the booth, and be among the first to discover exciting new additions to the
Aputure lineup that further expand our professional lighting ecosystem.

### ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The
### CEO behind this year's pancreatic cancer breakthrough walks us through the full results and
### implications | 05/31/26

Dr. Mark Goldsmith of Revolution Medicines describes the benefit seen by advanced patients who
received the pancreatic cancer pill daraxonrasib vs those in a control group of investigator's
choice standard-of-care chemotherapy, and he discusses the medicine's side effect profile. Plus,
next steps for this treatment in pancreatic cancer and beyond.
[ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative head &
neck | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
05:44

### ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
### shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative
### head & neck | 05/31/26

CEO Claire Mazumdar describes the ASCO data, and updates us on the phase 2/3 study, which is already
in the phase 3 portion. Bicara hopes to use the study to eventually gain an accelerated approval.
[ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
35:05

### ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.
[ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO data
release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26]
Play Video
Play Video
14:55

### ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO
### data release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26

Maky Zanganeh and Dave Gancarz share their take on the result, which at the topline showed that
Ivonescimab plus chemo reduced the risk of death by 34% vs the PD-1 Tislelizumab plus chemo, and
they are given the opportunity to respond to some of the pushback heard around McCormick Place.
[ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2- breast
| 06/02/26]
Play Video
Play Video
09:22

### ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
### gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2-
### breast | 06/02/26

These data were for patients with the PIK3CA mutation. The median PFS for the gedatolisib triplet
combo was 11.1 months versus 5.6 months, compared to alpelisib plus fulvestrant.
[ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK in
1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not overshadow this
| 06/1/26]
Play Video
Play Video
15:58

### ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK
### in 1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not
### overshadow this | 06/1/26

He describes the data, which showed a 17.3 months median OS in 55 patients vs. 8.5 months for SoC,
and descrbies why he believes the therapy has an ideal profile for first line patients. A phase
three study is already active and accruing patients.
[ASCO 2026: Known for its leadership in antibody-drug conjugates, Daiichi Sankyo's US CEO and new
Head of Global R&D discuss ASCO data and investments it will be making throughout oncology |
06/01/26]
Play Video

cover ASCO and pipeline progress on Enhertu (Her2), Datroway (Trop2), the company's B7-H3.

data | 05/31/26]

## [Lawn Grass Suppliers in Brisbane: Their Transportation and Installation Services][32]

A lawn grass supplier in Brisbane is likely to comprehend the impact of weather on turf installation
in any location, regardless of whether it is residential or commercial. Choosing appropriate and
quality grass is among the many facets of the process, but it’s not the only important aspect.
Delivery and setup services from lawn grass suppliers significantly influence the quality of the
work. Such treatments could greatly affect the lifetime and overall function of the new grass being
placed. When laying turf in areas known for excessive humidity, weather fluctuations, and extreme
heat, it is very important to consider these elements.

 

## Providing Consistent, Well Run Delivery Services

Most Brisbane lawn suppliers are well-known for their services around the region. Delivery options
differ only according to the type of grass, distance, and order size. From modest yards to big
commercial sites, turf suppliers can handle a wide range of order sizes. Turf suppliers usually
harvest the grass on the same day it is delivered to ensure quality.

 

It is imperative to complete this step, as the grass will begin to degrade rapidly if it is exposed
to the sun or warmer temperatures. Turf suppliers recognise that expedited delivery choices can
shield the grass from drying out or overheating prior to installation. For this reason, most lawn
grass suppliers prefer to deliver the turf early in the morning.

 

Some suppliers will also offer clients same-day or next-day delivery options, which depend on the
availability at the time. Clients who live in more rural areas or hard-to-access parts of the region
may need to plan for delivery ahead of time or pay a delivery surcharge.

 

## Installation Services: Do-It-Yourself or Obtain Professional Assistance?

When it comes to installing turf, clients have a choice to either lay the turf themselves or hire a
professional turf supplier service. If you have landscaping experience, you could likely install the
turf yourself, especially if the site is smaller and less complex. However, turf installation does
require a lot of physical effort, mostly from having to roll out the turf pieces, which can be quite
heavy.

 

It also requires leveling the ground or soil before installing it, which can be strenuous on its
own. Some turf suppliers offer complete installation packages, which include the following:

 
* Application of fertiliser on soil.
* The preparation of the site includes tilling and levelling the soil.
* To ensure complete soil contact, they will roll and compact the turf.
* To ensure the turf fits at the designated site, they will lay and cut it.
* They provide aftercare and watering instructions to ensure longevity.

 

Having turf installed professionally ensures that it will be laid properly and quickly. This reduces
the risk of things such as uneven seams, gaps, and poor establishment of the roots.

 

## Site Positioning and Access

To ensure that delivery trucks can easily offload pallets closer to the installation site, lawn

suppliers will provide mechanical forklifts to help with easier placement, especially for heavy
orders.

## [Top Swimming Pool Design Trends Gold Coast 2025][35]

[July 16, 2025July 7, 2025][36]

A swimming pool is not just a place to cool your body from the extreme Gold Coast heat, but also a
perfect place where you can relax and unwind after a long and tiresome day or week. Swimming pools
form a great part of outdoor living in many Gold Coast homes, making it necessary to understand the
different types of pools that exist on the Gold Coast to make an informed decision.

Whether you are thinking of building a new pool or renovating the existing one, here are the top
trend designs for swimming pools on the Gold Coast.

## Exceptional swimming pool design trends in Gold COAS

### Smaller and Smarter Pools

Not everyone has space for a large pool. Many homeowners now choose plunge pools or small lap pools.
These pools save space and money as they require very little space and resources to build. They also
work well in city homes or smaller backyards and are highly recommended for homeowners with very
little space in their backyards.

### Natural-looking pools

Today, human activities have greatly transformed the environment, and it is hard to distinguish
between nature and man-made features. Therefore, many people want pools that look like part of
nature in 2025. This means using soft shapes, natural stone, and plants around the pool to achieve a
natural-looking finish. Some even choose a lagoon or rock pool style to blend in with their garden.

### Smart pool technology

Smart pools are becoming very popular on the Gold Coast. You can now control pool lights, heating,
and cleaning systems from your phone wherever you happen to be. Some systems even test water quality
and add chemicals automatically with absolutely no human intervention. This makes pool care easier
and faster.

### Dark interiors

Pools with darker colours like deep blue or charcoal are trendy now in most swimming pools. These
colours help keep the water warm and give the pool a modern, stylish look. They also hide dirt
better than light colours, allowing you to use the pool for a long period without maintenance.

### Glass pool fencing

Glass fences are popular because they are safe and look great. They do not block the view and make
the pool area feel open and modern. This is important for families with kids or pets. It is one of
the most preferred options for hotels that are hidden in nature or in beautiful scenery to attract
tourists.

### LED lighting

Lighting is a big part of pool design in 2025 on the Gold Coast. LED lights are used inside the pool
and around the edges to increase visibility and appearance at night. You can change colours to match
your mood or a special event. This allows you to safely use the pool in a dark condition.

### Mineral pools

Instead of treating the pool with chlorine, more people on the Gold Coast are now going for mineral
pools. The most common mineral is magnesium, which is gentler on the skin and eyes. Mineral water
can also make your skin feel soft and healthy.

## Final Thoughts

Swimming pools on the Gold Coast in 2025 are stylish, smart, and eco-friendly. Whether you want a
small plunge pool or a luxury infinity pool, there are many great design ideas to choose from. With
smart tech, natural looks, and eco features, your pool can become the perfect place to relax and
enjoy life outdoors.

Want to add a pool to your property? Talk with [local swimming pool builders on Gold Coast][37]
right away.

## [Tree Removal in Adelaide: When and Why You Might Need It][38]

[March 2, 2025][39]

Trees add beauty, shade, and environmental benefits to any property, but there are times when they
need to be removed for safety and practicality. Whether due to disease, structural risks, or
construction needs, professional [tree removal adelaide][40] services can help safely and
efficiently remove unwanted or hazardous trees. Understanding when and why tree removal is necessary
can help homeowners make informed decisions about their landscapes.

#### **1. When is Tree Removal Necessary?**
* **Dead or Dying Trees**
  A tree that is no longer healthy can become a safety hazard. Dead branches or an entirely dead
  tree can fall unexpectedly, causing damage to property or injury to people.
* **Structural Damage or Instability**
  Trees with weakened roots, large cracks, or leaning trunks may be at risk of collapsing.
  Structural instability often occurs due to storm damage, soil erosion, or old age.
* **Disease and Pest Infestation**
  If a tree is infected with disease or infested by pests, removal may be the best option to prevent
  the problem from spreading to nearby trees and plants. Signs of disease include discolored leaves,
  fungal growth, and decaying wood.
* **Encroaching on Property or Infrastructure**
  Trees that grow too close to buildings, fences, power lines, or underground utilities can cause
  structural damage. Roots may crack foundations or interfere with plumbing systems, while branches
  can damage roofs or electrical lines.

heat, it is very important to consider these elements.

 

## Providing Consistent, Well Run Delivery Services

Most Brisbane lawn suppliers are well-known for their services around the region. Delivery options
differ only according to the type of grass, distance, and order size. From modest yards to big
commercial sites, turf suppliers can handle a wide range of order sizes. Turf suppliers usually
harvest the grass on the same day it is delivered to ensure quality.

 

It is imperative to complete this step, as the grass will begin to degrade rapidly if it is exposed
to the sun or warmer temperatures. Turf suppliers recognise that expedited delivery choices can
shield the grass from drying out or overheating prior to installation. For this reason, most lawn
grass suppliers prefer to deliver the turf early in the morning.

 

Some suppliers will also offer clients same-day or next-day delivery options, which depend on the
availability at the time. Clients who live in more rural areas or hard-to-access parts of the region
may need to plan for delivery ahead of time or pay a delivery surcharge.

 

## Installation Services: Do-It-Yourself or Obtain Professional Assistance?

When it comes to installing turf, clients have a choice to either lay the turf themselves or hire a
professional turf supplier service. If you have landscaping experience, you could likely install the
turf yourself, especially if the site is smaller and less complex. However, turf installation does
require a lot of physical effort, mostly from having to roll out the turf pieces, which can be quite
heavy.

 

It also requires leveling the ground or soil before installing it, which can be strenuous on its
own. Some turf suppliers offer complete installation packages, which include the following:

 
* Application of fertiliser on soil.
* The preparation of the site includes tilling and levelling the soil.
* To ensure complete soil contact, they will roll and compact the turf.
* To ensure the turf fits at the designated site, they will lay and cut it.
* They provide aftercare and watering instructions to ensure longevity.

 

Having turf installed professionally ensures that it will be laid properly and quickly. This reduces
the risk of things such as uneven seams, gaps, and poor establishment of the roots.

 

## Site Positioning and Access

To ensure that delivery trucks can easily offload pallets closer to the installation site, lawn
grass suppliers will ask for clear access to the area. If access to the site is restricted, there

suppliers will provide mechanical forklifts to help with easier placement, especially for heavy
orders.

## [Top Swimming Pool Design Trends Gold Coast 2025][35]

[July 16, 2025July 7, 2025][36]

A swimming pool is not just a place to cool your body from the extreme Gold Coast heat, but also a
perfect place where you can relax and unwind after a long and tiresome day or week. Swimming pools
form a great part of outdoor living in many Gold Coast homes, making it necessary to understand the
different types of pools that exist on the Gold Coast to make an informed decision.

Whether you are thinking of building a new pool or renovating the existing one, here are the top
trend designs for swimming pools on the Gold Coast.

## Exceptional swimming pool design trends in Gold COAS

### Smaller and Smarter Pools

Not everyone has space for a large pool. Many homeowners now choose plunge pools or small lap pools.
These pools save space and money as they require very little space and resources to build. They also
work well in city homes or smaller backyards and are highly recommended for homeowners with very
little space in their backyards.

### Natural-looking pools

Today, human activities have greatly transformed the environment, and it is hard to distinguish
between nature and man-made features. Therefore, many people want pools that look like part of
nature in 2025. This means using soft shapes, natural stone, and plants around the pool to achieve a
natural-looking finish. Some even choose a lagoon or rock pool style to blend in with their garden.

### Smart pool technology

Smart pools are becoming very popular on the Gold Coast. You can now control pool lights, heating,
and cleaning systems from your phone wherever you happen to be. Some systems even test water quality
and add chemicals automatically with absolutely no human intervention. This makes pool care easier
and faster.

### Dark interiors

Pools with darker colours like deep blue or charcoal are trendy now in most swimming pools. These
colours help keep the water warm and give the pool a modern, stylish look. They also hide dirt
better than light colours, allowing you to use the pool for a long period without maintenance.

### Glass pool fencing

Glass fences are popular because they are safe and look great. They do not block the view and make
the pool area feel open and modern. This is important for families with kids or pets. It is one of
the most preferred options for hotels that are hidden in nature or in beautiful scenery to attract
tourists.

### LED lighting

Lighting is a big part of pool design in 2025 on the Gold Coast. LED lights are used inside the pool
and around the edges to increase visibility and appearance at night. You can change colours to match
your mood or a special event. This allows you to safely use the pool in a dark condition.

### Mineral pools

Instead of treating the pool with chlorine, more people on the Gold Coast are now going for mineral
pools. The most common mineral is magnesium, which is gentler on the skin and eyes. Mineral water
can also make your skin feel soft and healthy.

## Final Thoughts

Swimming pools on the Gold Coast in 2025 are stylish, smart, and eco-friendly. Whether you want a
small plunge pool or a luxury infinity pool, there are many great design ideas to choose from. With
smart tech, natural looks, and eco features, your pool can become the perfect place to relax and
enjoy life outdoors.

Want to add a pool to your property? Talk with [local swimming pool builders on Gold Coast][37]
right away.

## [Tree Removal in Adelaide: When and Why You Might Need It][38]

[March 2, 2025][39]

Trees add beauty, shade, and environmental benefits to any property, but there are times when they
need to be removed for safety and practicality. Whether due to disease, structural risks, or
construction needs, professional [tree removal adelaide][40] services can help safely and
efficiently remove unwanted or hazardous trees. Understanding when and why tree removal is necessary
can help homeowners make informed decisions about their landscapes.

#### **1. When is Tree Removal Necessary?**
* **Dead or Dying Trees**
  A tree that is no longer healthy can become a safety hazard. Dead branches or an entirely dead
  tree can fall unexpectedly, causing damage to property or injury to people.
* **Structural Damage or Instability**
  Trees with weakened roots, large cracks, or leaning trunks may be at risk of collapsing.
  Structural instability often occurs due to storm damage, soil erosion, or old age.
* **Disease and Pest Infestation**
  If a tree is infected with disease or infested by pests, removal may be the best option to prevent
  the problem from spreading to nearby trees and plants. Signs of disease include discolored leaves,
  fungal growth, and decaying wood.
* **Encroaching on Property or Infrastructure**
  Trees that grow too close to buildings, fences, power lines, or underground utilities can cause
  structural damage. Roots may crack foundations or interfere with plumbing systems, while branches
  can damage roofs or electrical lines.
* **Clearing for Construction or Landscaping Projects**
  If you’re planning a renovation, driveway expansion, or landscaping makeover, tree removal may be
  required to make space for new structures or garden designs.

#### **2. Why Hire Professionals for Tree Removal?**
* **Safety and Expertise**
  Removing trees, especially large ones, requires skill and experience to avoid accidents.
  Professionals use specialized equipment and techniques to cut, lower, and dispose of trees safely.

  In Adelaide, tree removal may be subject to council regulations. Some trees are protected,

  paperwork.
* **Proper Waste Disposal**
  Tree removal generates a significant amount of debris. Professional services ensure proper
  disposal, including recycling wood or turning it into mulch.

#### **Final Thoughts**

Tree removal is sometimes essential for safety, property maintenance, or landscaping changes. If you

* Pałac Kultury w Dreźnie – dla WISAG
* Hilton Munich Airport (2017–2018)
* Centrum Targowe w Monachium (2019)
  **bezpośrednio dla Kreutzpointner**
* Projekty dla Kreutzpointner

[E-elektrik]

### Firmy instalacyjne / branżowe

[E-elektrik]
* **DELUX Elektro GmbH**
  firma z Berlina specjalizująca się w kompleksowych instalacjach elektrycznych i usługach
  konserwacyjnych.
* **Claus Heinemann Elektroanlagen GmbH**
  duży wykonawca instalacji niskiego i wysokiego napięcia, także utrzymanie i serwis.
* **InPro electric (Wolfsburg)**
  firma z obszaru infrastruktury i instalacji przemysłowych.
* **Bright Electrical Contractors GmbH**
  wykonawca “Electrical Services” na projektach budowlanych.
* **BML GmbH (Gräfelfing koło Monachium)**
  realizuje kompleksowe instalacje elektryczne przemysłowe i budowlane.
* **Elektro Hartmann GmbH**
  firma z Hamburga/Berlinu, wykonuje instalacje, obsługę i nadzór techniczny. Sieci i pośrednicy
  oferujący zlecenia/kontrakty jako podwykonawca
* **LETUSWORK Europe**
  platforma/pośrednik, który zapewnia kontrakty elektryczne jako podwykonawcy dla małych i średnich
  firm na dużych projektach w Niemczech i Europie. letuswork.eu
* **Personal-aus-Osteuropa.de**
  pośrednik łączący zespoły i podwykonawców elektryków z firmami niemieckimi (instalacje, projekty
  przemysłowe, montaż).
* **Zeitarbeit International**
  agencja zatrudniająca doświadczonych elektryków / podwykonawców z Europy Wschodniej.

  germany.leadec-services.com

If you’re looking to learn all about electronics and electrical engineering – you’ve come to the

Electrical4U is dedicated to the teaching and sharing of all things related to electrical and
electronics engineering.

To learn about basic Electrical Engineering, check out our articles on [Voltage][76], [Current][77],
[Transformers][78], [Single Phase Transformers][79], [Step Down Transformers][80], [Step Up

As a UK Charity, our mission is to prevent deaths and injuries caused by electricity through
improving people’s awareness of risks, and influencing both government policy and industry
standards.

[How we save lives][38]

## BATTRY BREAKDOWN

The UK is facing a worrying spike in fires connected to lithium-ion batteries. Explore our
Ground-breaking report and resources looking at the dangers of e-bike and e-scooter batteries.

Safety advice

### Keeping your family and home safe

Electricity keeps our homes running—but it can also pose serious risks if not handled properly.
Whether you're boiling the kettle, charging your phone, or rewiring a plug, knowing how to stay safe
is essential. This section offers clear, practical advice for every room and the people in your
home.

[Safety advice for you][41]

As an electrician, you know the importance of working safely with electricity, but even experienced
professionals benefit from staying up to date with best practices. This section offers practical
guidance to help you maintain high safety standards on every job, whether you're installing a
consumer unit, inspecting wiring, or advising clients on safe appliance use.

[Resources for electricians][42]

# POWERING CHANGE + SAVING LIVES

As a UK Charity, our mission is to prevent deaths and injuries caused by electricity through
improving people’s awareness of risks, and influencing both government policy and industry
standards.

[How we save lives][38]

## BATTRY BREAKDOWN

The UK is facing a worrying spike in fires connected to lithium-ion batteries. Explore our
Ground-breaking report and resources looking at the dangers of e-bike and e-scooter batteries.

[View the campaign][39]

## The Electrical Product Safety Conference

Our industry leading event is back! Register now to secure your spot.

[Register Now][40]
Safety advice
Resources for electricians
Safety advice

### Keeping your family and home safe

Electricity keeps our homes running—but it can also pose serious risks if not handled properly.
Whether you're boiling the kettle, charging your phone, or rewiring a plug, knowing how to stay safe
is essential. This section offers clear, practical advice for every room and the people in your
home.

[Safety advice for you][41]
[0E60fa15a1fe1749a0d8dbc8e36c8a2d63ef25e4 (1)]
Resources for electricians

### Expert guidance for electrical professionals.

As an electrician, you know the importance of working safely with electricity, but even experienced
professionals benefit from staying up to date with best practices. This section offers practical
guidance to help you maintain high safety standards on every job, whether you're installing a
consumer unit, inspecting wiring, or advising clients on safe appliance use.

[Resources for electricians][42]

Rick oversees estimating operations, supports estimator development, and works closely with project

Purdue with a degree in Construction Engineering and Management in 1990.  In 2006, Tim decided it
was time to start a new electrical contracting company, focusing on top craftsmanship, ideals in the
marketplace, and hire top-notch employees who embody his goals. So out of his garage and with two
electricians, they started Electric Plus.  Tim is on the Hendricks County 4-H Fair board and a 4-H
Leader for over 30 years. He is a member of the Central Indiana NECA Board of Directors, Indiana AGC
board of directors, and a board member of the Hendricks County Community Foundation. Tim is an avid
runner, and enjoys time at the lake with his family and friends.  He is also a big Purdue University
fan.  You will definitely see Tim at the football and basketball games with his family.  Boiler Up!!

# Sustainable Solutions for Electricity Distribution

We are an international technology company and a family business, which enables green transition,
reliable and safe supply of electricity by creating sustainable solutions for electricity
distribution.

## We Adapt

Global warming, extreme weather conditions, growing urbanization, and increased electrification
demand smarter and more resilient electrical infrastructures. Our innovative solutions adapt to
these challenges and combat climate change, providing sustainable, long-term answers.

A concise overview of key developments taking place in Japan in the last three to four months
surrounding various technological sectors.

## Hager Group, an independent family company shaping tomorrow’s electrical world.

Hager Group is a leading provider of solutions and services for electrical installations in
residential, commercial and industrial buildings. Our range of solutions and services extends from
energy distribution to cable management and from security systems to building automation. As an
independent family-owned and family-run company based in Blieskastel, Germany, we are one of the
industry’s innovation leaders. 13.000 employees generate sales of around 3,0 billion euros (2024).
Our components and solutions are produced at 23 locations around the globe and customers in 100
countries all over the world trust in them. We owe our success to their trust.
[About us][20]

## Hager Annual and Sustainability Report 2025/26

The world around us continues to evolve at an unprecedented pace. Rapid technological advances, the
energy transition, increasing sustainability expectations, and changing customer needs are reshaping
our industry and creating new opportunities for growth. Against this backdrop, our focus remains
clear: to build a resilient business that delivers lasting value while helping our customers
navigate the transformation of the energy landscape. 

This Annual Report reflects the progress we have made over the past year and the strategic direction
that continues to guide our journey. It tells the story of a company that is transforming with
purpose—combining operational excellence, innovation, and sustainability to strengthen our
competitive position and prepare for the future.

[Discover the full online version][21]
[annual_report_1024x1024]

## Our approach to sustainability

We want to shape tomorrow’s electrical world and make people’s life on our planet safer, cleaner and
more enjoyable through our actions and with our products. And, our sustainability policy is just one
of the ways to get there.
[Find out more][22]
[about hager group]

## Our values

Our company founders’ courageous entrepreneurial spirit, authenticity and integrity continue to
shape our future and make us who we are. Our values are at the heart of everything we do and form
the basis of our success.
[Find out more][23]
[hg_our_values]

### Landscape Irrigation

Founded in 1981, Hunter Industries is a global manufacturer of products for the irrigation sector.
We offer a complete spectrum of water- and energy-efficient solutions for residential, commercial,
municipal, and agricultural applications. Our core mission will always remain the same: to deliver
valued products and services backed by unwavering customer support.

[Visit Site][38]
×
[Hunter]

### Golf

Hunter Industries has been on the forefront of golf course irrigation technology for more than three
decades. We build performance, reliability, and serviceability into every product. From
industry-leading rotor technology to intuitive irrigation control software, we take pride in
providing golf professionals the tools and support they need to conceptualize, create, and manage
world-class golf courses.

[Visit Site][39]
×
[FX Luminaire]

### Landscape & Architectural Lighting

FX Luminaire is an industry-leading manufacturer of landscape and architectural lighting solutions.
We focus on the advancement of LED technology and digital lighting control with smart home
integration and zoning, dimming, and color generation capabilities. We offer a full spectrum of
lighting fixtures and accessories to create elegant landscape lighting systems for commercial and
residential applications.

[Visit Site][40]
×
[Lumascape]

### Architectural & Facade Lighting

Lumascape transforms spaces with precision-engineered lighting solutions proven to perform. Since
1991, customers have relied on us to solve their toughest lighting challenges. Our global experts
combine sophisticated design, advanced technologies, quality materials, and rigorous testing to
manufacture comprehensive lighting systems that consistently exceed performance expectations.

[Visit Site][41]
×
[Hunter]

### Agricultural Irrigation

Hunter® Agricultural Irrigation is a leading designer and manufacturer of quality Senninger®
irrigation solutions for agricultural, horticultural, and industrial applications. Our global
experts in the field work with growers to help us develop products with real irrigation solutions
that use as little water and energy as possible to make the most of every drop. With over 6 decades
of experience in more than 90 countries worldwide, Senninger products are among the most trusted in
the irrigation industry.

[Visit Site][42]
×
[Dispensing Dynamics]

### Dispensing Technologies

As the original inventors of the away-from-home dispensing category, Dispensing Dynamics is proud to
continue a longstanding tradition of innovation with a range of dispensing systems that offer
unsurpassed reliability, design, performance, hygiene, and sustainability.

[Visit Site][43]
×
[Hunter]

### Custom Manufacturing

Hunter Custom Manufacturing is an integrated division of Hunter Industries. We provide customers
with state-of-the-art manufacturing solutions, tooling, quality control, and global logistics. We
are an ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100 Rev D certified company. Our logistics team delivers finished goods
around the world.

[About][45]

### Who We Are

We provide top-quality solutions for a range of sectors worldwide

Hunter Industries is a global, family-owned company that provides innovative solutions of the
highest quality for the irrigation, outdoor lighting, dispensing technology, and custom
manufacturing industries. Our products are found everywhere from residential landscapes, commercial
complexes, and golf courses to stadiums, national landmarks, and municipal buildings worldwide.
Whether you’re from New York, Shanghai, Sydney, Paris, Moscow, Buenos Aires, or Cairo, you’ve
probably encountered a Hunter product somewhere along the way.

[Learn More][46]
[[About Hunter Industries]][47]
 
[Great Ideas][48]

### Innovation Is the Cornerstone of Hunter Industries

Welcome to the Great Ideas innovation website for Hunter Industries. We created this portal to
manage innovation development within Hunter Industries and invite you to join our efforts. From new
product development and product enhancements to sustainability and manufacturing, we want to hear
from you!

[Learn More][49]
[[Great Ideas]][50]
[[Social Responsibility]][51]
[Social Responsibility][52]

### Advancing Growth with Purpose

At Hunter, our core value of Social Responsibility guides us to make decisions today that create a
better tomorrow — especially as we grow. That’s why we’re committed to pursuing clear Sustainability
and Social Impact goals that help us balance the well-being of people, the health of the planet, and
the success of our business. We track our progress and share key outcomes each year through our
annual Impact Report.

[Learn More][53]
[Community][54]

### A Commitment to Our Communities

To demonstrate our core values of Family and Social Responsibility, Hunter Industries has a
longstanding history of supporting the communities where our employees live, work, and play. We’re
proud to meet our commitments with charitable contributions, volunteerism, product donations, and
outreach.

[Learn More][55]
[[Hunter employees volunteering]][56]

## How We Complete Electrical Projects

Our systematic approach ensures quality, safety, and on-time completion

1

### Initial Assessment and Planning

Project evaluation, electrical load analysis, and comprehensive planning phase

#### Site Evaluation Process

Our licensed electricians conduct thorough site assessments to evaluate existing electrical systems,
identify code compliance requirements, and determine optimal electrical solutions for commercial and
industrial facilities throughout Mesa, Gilbert, Chandler, and East Valley locations.

#### Load Calculation and Design

We perform detailed electrical load calculations, circuit analysis, and power distribution planning
to ensure proper electrical capacity for your business operations. Our designs meet National
Electrical Code (NEC) standards and Arizona electrical requirements.

#### Permit and Documentation

Complete permit application, engineering documentation, and coordination with local electrical
inspectors to ensure smooth project approval and code compliance throughout the installation
process.

2

### Material Procurement and Scheduling

Professional-grade electrical materials sourcing and project timeline coordination

#### Quality Material Selection

We source commercial-grade electrical panels, conduit systems, wiring, circuit breakers, and
electrical components from trusted manufacturers to ensure long-term reliability and safety for your
electrical installation.

#### Project Scheduling Coordination

Our team coordinates project timelines with your business operations, scheduling electrical work
during off-peak hours when possible to minimize disruption to your daily activities and maintain
productivity.

#### Crew Assignment and Preparation

Licensed electricians are assigned based on project complexity and specialization requirements. All
crew members receive project briefings and safety protocol reviews before beginning electrical work.

3

### Professional Installation

Safe, code-compliant electrical installation by licensed professionals

#### Safety Protocol Implementation

Every electrical installation follows strict safety procedures including proper lockout/tagout
protocols, personal protective equipment usage, voltage testing, and OSHA compliance to protect
workers and facility occupants.

#### Code-Compliant Installation

All electrical work meets National Electrical Code (NEC) standards, Arizona electrical codes, and
local municipal requirements. We ensure proper grounding, circuit protection, and electrical system
integration.

#### Quality Control and Testing

Continuous quality monitoring throughout installation, with systematic testing of electrical
connections, circuit functionality, and system performance to ensure reliable operation.

4

### Testing and Inspection

Comprehensive electrical system testing and official inspection coordination

#### System Performance Testing

Complete electrical system testing including voltage verification, load testing, circuit
functionality, grounding system integrity, and safety device operation to ensure optimal electrical
performance.

#### Inspection Coordination

We coordinate with local electrical inspectors throughout Mesa, Gilbert, Chandler, Scottsdale, and
Tempe to ensure prompt inspection scheduling and successful approval of all electrical work.

#### Documentation and Certification

Comprehensive project documentation including electrical drawings, test results, inspection
certificates, and warranty information for your records and future electrical maintenance needs.

5

### Project Completion and Support

Final walkthrough, system training, and ongoing electrical support services

#### Client Walkthrough and Training

Detailed walkthrough of completed electrical work including explanation of new systems, safety
features, electrical panel organization, and basic troubleshooting guidance for facility management.

#### Warranty and Service Support

Comprehensive warranty coverage on electrical installation work with ongoing support for maintenance
questions, system optimization, and emergency electrical service needs.

#### Future Electrical Planning

Recommendations for future electrical upgrades, expansion planning, and preventive maintenance
scheduling to support your business growth and electrical system longevity.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Instagantt and Gantt chart project management.

### What is Instagantt?

Instagantt is an online Gantt chart software that helps you plan, schedule, and manage projects
visually. It provides drag-and-drop scheduling, task dependencies, milestones, workload management,
and AI-powered project generation.

### How does Instagantt integrate with Asana?

Instagantt connects directly to your Asana workspace and syncs bidirectionally in real time. All
your Asana tasks, subtasks, assignees, dates, and custom fields appear as a Gantt chart. Changes
made in either tool sync instantly to the other.

### Is there a free plan?

Yes. Instagantt offers a free forever plan that includes up to 3 Asana projects, Gantt chart view,
task management, and CSV export. No credit card is required to get started.

### How much does the paid plan cost?

The Individual plan is $12/month ($10/month billed annually) with unlimited projects. The Teams plan
is $24/month ($20/month billed annually) for 3 users, with additional users at $8/month each.

### What is the AI Assistant?

The AI Assistant lets you describe your project in plain English and instantly generates a fully
structured Gantt chart with tasks, dependencies, milestones, and duration estimates. It saves hours
of manual project setup.

### Can I use Instagantt without Asana?

Yes. While the Asana integration is a key feature, you can create standalone projects directly in
Instagantt without connecting to Asana. You can also import projects via CSV files.

### What are dependencies and why do they matter?

Dependencies are links between tasks that define their order. For example, you cannot start testing
until development is finished. Instagantt supports all four dependency types and automatically
reschedules downstream tasks when predecessor tasks move.

### What is the critical path?

The critical path is the longest chain of dependent tasks that determines the minimum project
duration. Instagantt highlights it visually so you can focus resources on the tasks that directly
impact your deadline.

### Can I share my Gantt chart with clients or stakeholders?

Yes. Instagantt lets you create public snapshots — shareable read-only URLs that anyone can view
without an account. You can also export charts as high-resolution PDF or PNG files.

### Does Instagantt support team collaboration?

Yes. The Teams plan includes real-time collaboration where multiple team members can edit the same
Gantt chart simultaneously. You can assign tasks, leave comments, and manage workloads across your
team.

### What is the Workload View?

The Workload View shows each team member's task assignments and capacity across all projects. It
highlights overallocation with visual indicators so you can redistribute work and prevent burnout
before deadlines slip.

### Can I set milestones in my project?

Yes. Milestones appear as diamond markers on your timeline and represent key deliverables or
decision points. They help stakeholders track progress at a high level without diving into
task-level detail.

### What is a baseline and how do I use it?

A baseline is a snapshot of your original project plan. Once saved, you can compare it against your
current schedule to see where tasks have shifted. This helps you track scope changes and communicate
schedule variance to stakeholders.

### Can I import data from Excel or CSV?

Yes. Instagantt supports CSV import, allowing you to bring in tasks, dates, and durations from
Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet tool. Your data is mapped to the Gantt chart automatically.

### Does Instagantt offer project templates?

Yes. Instagantt includes a template gallery with pre-built project plans for software development,
marketing campaigns, event planning, construction, and more. You can also save any project as a
custom template for future reuse.

### How does the Kanban Board work?

The Kanban Board shows your tasks as cards organized in columns by status (To Do, In Progress,
Done). You can drag cards between columns, and changes are reflected in the Gantt chart
automatically. It is perfect for agile workflows.

### Can I track time and costs?

Yes. Instagantt supports estimated hours and cost tracking per task. You can assign hourly rates,
set budgets, and track actual versus estimated time and cost across your project.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Instagantt and Gantt chart project management.

### What is Instagantt?

Instagantt is an online Gantt chart software that helps you plan, schedule, and manage projects
visually. It provides drag-and-drop scheduling, task dependencies, milestones, workload management,
and AI-powered project generation.

### How does Instagantt integrate with Asana?

Instagantt connects directly to your Asana workspace and syncs bidirectionally in real time. All
your Asana tasks, subtasks, assignees, dates, and custom fields appear as a Gantt chart. Changes
made in either tool sync instantly to the other.

### Is there a free plan?

Yes. Instagantt offers a free forever plan that includes up to 3 Asana projects, Gantt chart view,
task management, and CSV export. No credit card is required to get started.

### How much does the paid plan cost?

The Individual plan is $12/month ($10/month billed annually) with unlimited projects. The Teams plan
is $24/month ($20/month billed annually) for 3 users, with additional users at $8/month each.

### What is the AI Assistant?

The AI Assistant lets you describe your project in plain English and instantly generates a fully
structured Gantt chart with tasks, dependencies, milestones, and duration estimates. It saves hours
of manual project setup.

### Can I use Instagantt without Asana?

Yes. While the Asana integration is a key feature, you can create standalone projects directly in
Instagantt without connecting to Asana. You can also import projects via CSV files.

### What are dependencies and why do they matter?

Dependencies are links between tasks that define their order. For example, you cannot start testing
until development is finished. Instagantt supports all four dependency types and automatically
reschedules downstream tasks when predecessor tasks move.

### What is the critical path?

The critical path is the longest chain of dependent tasks that determines the minimum project
duration. Instagantt highlights it visually so you can focus resources on the tasks that directly
impact your deadline.

### Can I share my Gantt chart with clients or stakeholders?

Yes. Instagantt lets you create public snapshots — shareable read-only URLs that anyone can view
without an account. You can also export charts as high-resolution PDF or PNG files.

### Does Instagantt support team collaboration?

Yes. The Teams plan includes real-time collaboration where multiple team members can edit the same
Gantt chart simultaneously. You can assign tasks, leave comments, and manage workloads across your
team.

### What is the Workload View?

The Workload View shows each team member's task assignments and capacity across all projects. It
highlights overallocation with visual indicators so you can redistribute work and prevent burnout
before deadlines slip.

### Can I set milestones in my project?

Yes. Milestones appear as diamond markers on your timeline and represent key deliverables or
decision points. They help stakeholders track progress at a high level without diving into
task-level detail.

### What is a baseline and how do I use it?

A baseline is a snapshot of your original project plan. Once saved, you can compare it against your
current schedule to see where tasks have shifted. This helps you track scope changes and communicate
schedule variance to stakeholders.

### Can I import data from Excel or CSV?

Yes. Instagantt supports CSV import, allowing you to bring in tasks, dates, and durations from
Excel, Google Sheets, or any spreadsheet tool. Your data is mapped to the Gantt chart automatically.

### Does Instagantt offer project templates?

Yes. Instagantt includes a template gallery with pre-built project plans for software development,
marketing campaigns, event planning, construction, and more. You can also save any project as a
custom template for future reuse.

### How does the Kanban Board work?

The Kanban Board shows your tasks as cards organized in columns by status (To Do, In Progress,
Done). You can drag cards between columns, and changes are reflected in the Gantt chart
automatically. It is perfect for agile workflows.

### Can I track time and costs?

Yes. Instagantt supports estimated hours and cost tracking per task. You can assign hourly rates,
set budgets, and track actual versus estimated time and cost across your project.

regular deals and offers to save more. Shop securely using trusted payment gateways. From mobiles to
smart devices, we offer a wide range of top brands Electronics and Home Appliances to meet all your
needs. Shop smart, shop at Jumbo Electronics!

Find the latest mobile phones at Jumbo Electronics, your trusted online store for smartphones.
Explore top models like the [iPhone 16][246], [iPhone 16 Pro Max][247], and [Samsung Galaxy S25
Ultra][248], packed with advanced AI features. Shop foldable phones like the [Samsung Galaxy Z

purchase. Explore every photography style with the best digital cameras, action cameras, and drones.

Get the best deals on all the newly launched DSLRs, mirrorless cameras, action cameras, lenses, and
tripods from brands including Canon, Sony, Nikon, Go Pro, [GoPro HERO 13][252], and DJI drones,
[Insta360][253] cameras. Experience the power of the iMac with the M4 chip, stunning 24" Retina

## **Your Go-To Destination for the Best Laptops: AI, Gaming, Lightweight, and More**

laptops for work, gaming laptops, lightweight laptops, and portable options for students. Choose
from AI-powered models like the MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, and MacBook Pro M4. Whether for

MateBook 14, and HP Spectre X360. Enjoy seamless online shopping with easy comparisons, exclusive

in all aspects of our business.

# POWERING THE POSSIBILITIES

## JOIN THE TEAM

[Apply Today][48]

### OFFICE

Miller Electric is a proven industry leader that will provide you with the training, skills, and
experience to help you achieve your career goals.

[Learn more][49]

 

 

### FIELD

We are currently hiring trade professionals with all levels of experience. Make your mark in the
industry by working on some of the largest, high-profile projects in the nation.

[Learn More][50]

 

 

### Internships

We provide motivated college students with a hands-on learning experience through our
paid-internship program. Take the first step of your career with us!

[Learn More][51]

 

 

Who We Are

## Building Relationships

For almost 10 decades, we have focused on providing quality electrical solutions for our clients
while building meaningful careers for our people in an environment that encourages inclusivity,
development and balance. Our company is committed to the continued stewardship of our communities
and our industry as we look to build relationships that power the possibilities of a more connected
future.

[Learn More][52]

What We Do

## Innovative Solutions

Founded in 1928, we have grown from a local electrical contractor to one of the largest in the
industry with almost 5,000 employees. Our company has expanded its services beyond traditional
electrical contracting to include systems integration, connected communities, building automation,
business continuity, and energy & sustainability services. Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida,
we utilize a network of branch offices and industry partners to provide our clients with innovative
solutions and quality service so that they can remain focused on their core business.

[Learn More][53]

NEWS

U.S. region for Miller Electric Company and holds the role of Acting COO/Group President at
Morley-Moss.

[read more][56]

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

providing cutting-edge technology and empowering IT businesses to thrive. Our mission is to drive

optimal climate management, providing comfort while reducing energy consumption.

designs and user-friendly functionality, they enhance the overall user experience in home
automation.
KNX is a leading standard for home and building automation. It enables the interoperability of
various devices, allowing for a fully integrated smart home experience that enhances convenience and
efficiency.

  Integration of audio and video equipment into the multiroom system, media content management

  Providing all aspects of security, access control and video surveillance
* App and voice control
  Smartphone and tablet control, voice control, scripts, and other features
[SMART HOME CONCEPT ][32]

undertake.

Additionally, we provide specialized training and consulting services for installers and

Yes. We provide technical support, system integration assistance and smart home automation training

## High Voltage Fuses. Engineered Safety. Proven Performance.

**High‑Voltage Protection for Demanding Applications**

SCHURTER high‑voltage fuses deliver reliable performance – even under demanding electrical and
environmental conditions. Discover our portfolio engineered for maximum safety, high efficiency, and
long service life.

[Explore High‑Voltage Fuses][112]
[An EV Charging plug and a Inline Fuse to protect it]

## Latest news

[View all news][113]

## Our latest videos

[Play video]
[NPI ADO Preview]

### NPI Video ADO: High Performance DC Fuse

The new SCHURTER ADO series is a fuse with a rated current range of 10 to 63 A and a maximum
operating current of 40 A at 1000 VDC. It is designed for applications in direct current systems up
to 1000 VDC and is suitable for use in electric vehicles.
[Play video]
[Supercaps]

### Energy Harvesting with SCHURTER Supercaps

The demand for fast and reliable energy storage is increasing in our connected, all-electric world.
SCHURTER’s prismatic supercapacitors are the world’s thinnest supercaps, offering the perfect
solution for rapid energy storage and release.
[Play video]
[Supercap SCPA]

### NEW: Prismatic Supercaps

Supercaps are a special type of energy storage device that combine the best properties of
rechargeable batteries and capacitors. They can store enormous amounts of energy and release it very
quickly. Watch our product introduction video to learn more.
[Play video]

### 7 Tips for Developing 'The Perfect HMI'

In this video, we share recommendations to help you make the right decisions when developing a PCAP
touch panel. And this only in 7 steps!

## SCHURTER – Your Reliable Partner for Future-Proof Filter Solutions

Discover SCHURTER’s comprehensive range of power entry and line filters designed for demanding
industrial, medical and energy applications. From compact DIN-rail solutions and high-performance
3-phase filters to robust DC filters for PV and storage systems – our products ensure excellent
attenuation, safety and compliance with global standards. Whether for compact devices or
high-current systems, SCHURTER filters offer reliable EMI suppression, high quality and easy
integration.

**
Explore the range and find the ideal filter for your application. **

[Discover our Top-Running Filters][114]

## EMC-Filter Cross-Reference

Play it safe: Find your SCHURTER alternative here.

[Find your SCHURTER Filter now][115]

## Green Line

SCHURTER presents the first 10A and 16A In-/Outlets made of plant-based plastic worldwide! The new
Green Line family includes the types 6100-3, 6100-4, 6102-3, 6102-5, 6600-3, 6600-4, 4782, 4797,
4798 and 6080.

[Read more about Green Line][116]
[Green Line Products by SCHURTER made of Bioplastic]

## Our knowledge at your service

SCHURTER has extensive in-house expertise in engineering, manufacturing, supply chain management,
testing and qualification as well as in various services. This makes SCHURTER an independent,
reliable partner for our customers.

[Discover our Competences][117]

## Statement by the SCHURTER Group on Supply Chain Resilience

At SCHURTER, we operate as a globally active company with production facilities strategically
located across multiple regions. We continuously invest in these facilities to ensure they are
equipped with the latest technologies, enabling us to operate efficient, internationally connected
production sites.

Being a reliable partner to our customers is at the heart of everything we do. That is why we have
built robust and resilient supply chains—both in collaboration with our suppliers and within our
globally interconnected production network. These supply chains are regularly exposed to simulated
stress tests, allowing us to proactively identify and prevent potential vulnerabilities.

Even In the case of geopolitical shifts, we at SCHURTER are well-prepared to maintain our high level
of delivery reliability. Our customers can rely on us to remain a consistent and dependable
partner—even in uncertain times.

quickly. Watch our product introduction video to learn more.
[Play video]

### 7 Tips for Developing 'The Perfect HMI'

In this video, we share recommendations to help you make the right decisions when developing a PCAP
touch panel. And this only in 7 steps!

## SCHURTER – Your Reliable Partner for Future-Proof Filter Solutions

Discover SCHURTER’s comprehensive range of power entry and line filters designed for demanding
industrial, medical and energy applications. From compact DIN-rail solutions and high-performance
3-phase filters to robust DC filters for PV and storage systems – our products ensure excellent
attenuation, safety and compliance with global standards. Whether for compact devices or
high-current systems, SCHURTER filters offer reliable EMI suppression, high quality and easy
integration.

**
Explore the range and find the ideal filter for your application. **

[Discover our Top-Running Filters][114]

## EMC-Filter Cross-Reference

Play it safe: Find your SCHURTER alternative here.

[Find your SCHURTER Filter now][115]

## Green Line

SCHURTER presents the first 10A and 16A In-/Outlets made of plant-based plastic worldwide! The new
Green Line family includes the types 6100-3, 6100-4, 6102-3, 6102-5, 6600-3, 6600-4, 4782, 4797,
4798 and 6080.

[Read more about Green Line][116]
[Green Line Products by SCHURTER made of Bioplastic]

## Our knowledge at your service

SCHURTER has extensive in-house expertise in engineering, manufacturing, supply chain management,
testing and qualification as well as in various services. This makes SCHURTER an independent,
reliable partner for our customers.

[Discover our Competences][117]

## Statement by the SCHURTER Group on Supply Chain Resilience

At SCHURTER, we operate as a globally active company with production facilities strategically
located across multiple regions. We continuously invest in these facilities to ensure they are
equipped with the latest technologies, enabling us to operate efficient, internationally connected
production sites.

Being a reliable partner to our customers is at the heart of everything we do. That is why we have
built robust and resilient supply chains—both in collaboration with our suppliers and within our
globally interconnected production network. These supply chains are regularly exposed to simulated
stress tests, allowing us to proactively identify and prevent potential vulnerabilities.

Even In the case of geopolitical shifts, we at SCHURTER are well-prepared to maintain our high level
of delivery reliability. Our customers can rely on us to remain a consistent and dependable
partner—even in uncertain times.

01

### High-Quality ZGS□-12 Combined Transformer

The ZGS□-12 combined transformer is a compact, fully sealed American-style box transformer designed
for cable distribution networks. Integrating high-voltage control, protection, and distribution
equipment, it offers flexible ring-main or terminal power supply. Featuring low-loss transformers
and plug-in dry-type fuses, it suits various low-voltage feeder needs. Its compact, fully insulated
design ensures safety and reliability for urban and rural power grids.

Get Best Price
][145]

02

### YBWF/G-40.5/0.69 Wind Power Transformer/Photovoltaic Power Transformer

40.5kV and 12kV box-type step-up transformers for wind power and photovoltaic (solar) applications.
Designed for the growing renewable energy market, these transformers efficiently boost the standard
690V output from wind turbines or solar panels to a higher voltage (40.5kV/12kV) for effective power
collection and transmission within the farm grid. They are engineered to meet the specific demands
and environmental conditions of renewable energy projects in China.

Get Best Price
][146]
[
03

### SCB□ series 6-10kV Dry-Type Power Transformer

The S□-Series three-phase dry-type distribution transformers are energy-efficient solutions designed
for superior performance and reliability. Featuring epoxy resin-encapsulated coils, they offer
enhanced fire safety, low maintenance, and compact design. This series of products includes SCB18,
SCB14, SCB13, SCE312 and other series. To meet different energy standards, these transformers are
suitable for commercial, industrial and harsh environments. With capacities up to 2500kVA and
voltage levels ≤10kV, they ensure low loss, quiet operation, and strong short-circuit resistance.

Get Best Price
][147]

04

### S□ series 6-10kV Oil-Immersed Power Transformer

The S□ series three-phase oil-immersed distribution transformer is an energy-efficient solution
designed for daily lighting and factory power applications. With capacities up to 2500kVA and
voltage levels up to 6-10kV, it features low loss, low noise, and high short-circuit resistance.
Available in multiple series (S22, S20, S13, S11), it meets various national energy efficiency
standards (Level 1-3), allowing customers to select the ideal model based on their needs.

Get Best Price
][148]
[
01

### YB□ High Voltage/Low Voltage Prefabricated Substation

The YB□ series prefabricated substation is a compact, integrated solution for power distribution.
Combining high-voltage equipment, transformer, and low-voltage panels in one robust enclosure, it's
ideal for urban complexes, residential areas, industrial parks, and temporary sites. It offers
significant space savings, reliable operation, and flexible configurations like ring-main or dual
power supply. Compliant with GB/T 17467-2020, it ensures safe, efficient, and mobile power
distribution.

Get Best Price

01

### Indoor high voltage vacuum circuit breaker series

The Indoor high voltage vacuum circuit breaker series is a specialized, high-performance product
line designed for indoor high-voltage power distribution systems, integrating a variety of
functional handcarts to meet different application needs such as circuit protection, voltage
transformation, electric energy metering and electrical isolation. This series features standardized
configuration, stable operation and strong compatibility, widely used in high-voltage switch
cabinets, power distribution rooms, industrial and mining enterprises and urban power supply
networks, providing reliable support for the safe and stable operation of indoor power systems.

Get Best Price

02

### XGN15-12 Box-type Fixed Ring Main Unit Switchgear

The XGN15-12(F) and XGN15-12(F·R) are 12kV, 630A fixed indoor AC metal-enclosed switchgear units
designed for reliable power control and protection. Ideal for ring main or radial power supply
systems, they are particularly suited for prefabricated substations. Equipped with SF6 load switches
or fuse-combination load switches, this next-generation switchgear offers compact design, simple
operation, and high reliability, making it an excellent choice for urban grid renovation and
construction projects.

### TRXGN-12 Air (Environmentally Friendly Gas) Insulated Ring Main Unit

Our environmentally friendly, air-insulated AC metal-enclosed switchgear is a reliable and compact
solution for 12kV/50Hz power distribution. Developed with advanced technology, it is designed for
receiving and distributing electrical energy in substations, industrial plants, and urban complexes.
As an SF6-free product, it supports green grid initiatives. Its small size, easy installation, and
flexible operation make it a cost-effective choice for modernizing electrical infrastructure.

### MNS Low-Voltage Withdrawable Switchgear

AC 50(60)Hz systems up to 660V and 5000A, ideal for power distribution and motor control across
various sectors like power plants, industrial facilities, and infrastructure projects. The equipment
features a modular design with reliable mechanical interlocking for enhanced safety and operational
reliability.

### KYN28-12 Armoured Middle-Mounted Metal Enclosed Switchgear

The KYN28A-12 (GZS1-12) is a 3.6-12kV, 50Hz, indoor AC metal-clad, middle-mounted switchgear
designed for single busbar segmented systems. It serves as a high-performance distribution solution
for power plants, industrial facilities, substations, and large motor control. Complying with GB,
IEC, and DL standards, it features comprehensive safety interlocks, ensuring reliable control,
protection, and monitoring.

### KGNX-12 Indoor AC Metal-clad Fixed Switchgear

multi-functional vacuum circuit breaker or load switch. Designed for power reception, distribution,
control, and protection in three-phase 50(60)Hz systems, it is ideal for substations, industrial
plants, and high-rise buildings. Its miniaturized design (W500xD940xH2000mm) saves up to 58% space
compared to traditional models like KYN 28-12, offering superior flexibility and reliability.

### HXGN17-12 Box-type Fixed Metal Enclosed Switchgear

designed for 12kV, 50Hz three-phase systems. It is primarily used for power distribution and
protection in ring main networks, terminal power supply networks, and industrial electrical
installations. Complying with both GB3906 and IEC298 international standards, it ensures reliable
performance for receiving and distributing electrical energy, and is also suitable for integration
